text:
On the published home page (https://doodla.github.io/athena/), move the 'Owner view' link out of the header line that holds the newcomer's next step. Put it in a clearly labelled section for the project owner, and make its text say it is for the owner of this Athena deployment, not for a visitor. Acceptance: a test on the generated page asserts that (1) the header next-step line has no owner link, and (2) the owner link's text names the project owner as its reader.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Newcomer raters say the 'Owner view: proposals waiting for your decision' link sits beside the newcomer's next step and never says who 'your' means (2 ratings)
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
